evidence.title: Proof Launches ChatGPT Integration to Solve the AI Agent Trust Gap
evidence.body: [e001:f01] By bridging the "Agent Evidentiary Gap," the release enables businesses to verify that a specific person authorized an agent's financial or legal action, moving AI assistants from simple chat interfaces to secure transactional tools. [e001:f02] The company has released the Proof MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, a tool designed to bring verified identity into AI environments. [e001:f03] Now available through the ChatGPT app directory, the server allows users to connect their Proof identity wallet to their AI conversations. [e001:f04] The primary feature of this initial release is the implementation of x401, an open protocol launched by Proof on October 15, 2026. [e001:f05] When an AI agent attempts to access a service or complete a transaction—such as signing a legal document or moving funds—the destination site can issue an x401 challenge. [e001:f06] The Proof MCP then presents this request to the user, who reviews the specific terms and approves the action using a biometric signature. [e001:f07] If any terms are altered after the signature, the verification fails. [e001:f08] For businesses, the system allows them to verify signatures offline without requiring a direct integration with ChatGPT itself. [e001:f09] In September, we covered how [Circle Launches Arc: The Institutional Layer 1 Blockchain for the AI Agent Economy](https:// which provided a financial foundation for autonomous agents. [e001:f10] The "Agent Evidentiary Gap" has been the single largest hurdle preventing AI agents from moving beyond simple information retrieval into high-value transactions. [e001:f11] Until now, a password or API key only proved that an agent had access, not that a human had specifically authorized a $5,000 transfer or a contract signature. [e001:f12] By making x401 available in ChatGPT, Proof is forcing the hand of traditional financial institutions and retailers who have previously blocked AI agents as a security risk. [e001:f13] 18, 2026** — Proof, the identity authorization company, today released the first version of the Proof MCP, its Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants, now available in ChatGPT. [e001:f14] The first flow featured in the MCP is x401, meaning anyone using ChatGPT can now add the Proof app and let the assistant carry their verified identity into its work. [e001:f15] When ChatGPT reaches a website or service that asks who authorized a request, the person reviews the details, approves with a biometric, and the business verifies the signature for itself. [e001:f16] This first release centers on x401, and Proof will add more of its offerings to the same MCP o。

evidence.title: OpenAI targets clinical admin burden with autonomous ‘agent’ launch
evidence.body: [e004:f01] On 16 November OpenAI announced software that can do this work. [e004:f02] The launch is aimed at the American market. [e004:f03] Google launched a rival product six days earlier, in US preview, with connectors reaching more than 400 healthcare applications. [e004:f04] The 10 Year Health Plan commits to a Single Patient Record joining GP, hospital and social care data, with an ambition that patients can see it through the NHS App from 2028. [e004:f05] NHS England is investing £10bn in technology over three years and has said it will favour AI tools integrated with the electronic patient record over standalone ones. [e004:f06] The evidence for reliability is thinner than the launch suggests. [e004:f07] A Stanford benchmark published in April tested agents on insurance-related administrative work across a simulated records system, two payer portals and a fax queue. [e004:f08] The models tested pre-date this launch, and OpenAI has not, according to reporting on it, disclosed workflow-level error rates for its new agents. [e004:f09] The clinical safety standards that apply to health IT, DCB0129 and DCB0160, assume a defined product with a manufacturer's hazard log and a deploying organisation's safety officer. [e004:f10] An agent that navigates a screen is a moving target, because a supplier's interface update can change its behaviour without anyone informing the trust. [e004:f11] Identity raises a second problem. [e004:f12] If an agent acts under a clinician's login, the audit trail records a person who took no part in the action, which complicates both a Data Security and Protection Toolkit return and any later inquiry into a referral sent to the wrong service. [e004:f13] Trusts should insist that any agent works under its own identity with its own log, and should test end-to-end success locally before scaling anything. [e004:f14] Policymakers should resist treating agent capability as a reason to relax interoperability requirements on suppliers, since an agent that clicks through a poorly designed system leaves the design as poor as it was. [e004:f15] Screen-reading agents are the most capable bridge yet offered, and a Single Patient Record planned for 2028 gives the best reason to keep them temporary. [e004:f16] The test over the next two years is whether the service uses the agents to survive until the record exists, with failure rates published and interfaces still mandated, or lets them become the reason it never arrives.

evidence.title: エヌビディアのロボティクス責任者、OpenAIの「Astra」を称賛 半導体調査拡大と決算発表を前に
evidence.body: [e005:f01] エヌビディアのロボティクス責任者が、競合他社の人工知能モデルを公に支持し、OpenAIのGPT-6 Astraを、言語を理解して行動する必要のある機械にとって前向きな進展だと評した。 [e005:f02] しかし独立系ベンチマークでは、同モデルは人間より約100倍遅く、タスクあたり16.36ドル（約2,600円）のコストがかかり、精密作業では失速することが示されている。 [e005:f03] この称賛は、エヌビディアのチップがシンガポールのMegaspeed Internationalに渡り、中国へ転用された可能性があるとして連邦当局の調査を受けている最中に発表された。 [e005:f04] エヌビディアは11月17日に決算を発表する。 [e005:f05] 売上高ガイダンスは1,080億ドル（約17.2兆円）で中国のデータセンター売上を含まない前提。 [e005:f06] Artificial Analysisは「AA-Robotics v0.1」と銘打った研究プレビューで、Astraを5つの主要モデル中1位とし、スコア69.4でGPT-6.1 Sol、Gemini 4 Argon、2つのClaudeモデルを上回った。 [e005:f07] モデル AA-Roboticsスコア（0〜100） GPT-6 Astra 69.4 GPT-6.1 Sol 64.6 Gemini 4 Argon 55.3 Claude Opus 5.5 48.8 Claude Fable 5.1 46.3 Astraの優位性には代償が伴った。 [e005:f08] またAstraはタスクあたり16.36ドル（約2,600円）と最も高価で、最安モデルGPT-6.1 Solの平均1.93ドル（約310円）の8倍以上だった（同モデルのスコアは64.6）。 [e005:f09] ミリ単位の精度が求められるより難しいタスク、すなわちパズルピースを狭い丸いスロットに押し込む作業では、Astraは20回中2回、つまり10%の成功でFable 5.1と並んだ。 [e005:f10] 米商務省は2024年、機微なチップの転用監視中に不審な動きを察知して調査を開始。 [e005:f11] 11月16日、米商務省産業安全保障局は、輸出管理をリモートアクセスに拡大する暫定最終規則も公表した。 [e005:f12] 売上高は962億ドル（約15.3兆円）に達し、前年同期比106%増。 [e005:f13] 第3四半期について同社は1,080億ドル（約17.2兆円）±2%をガイダンスとし、中国からのデータセンター計算売上を含まない前提だと述べた。 [e005:f14] 粗利益率は前四半期の75%から74%に低下する見通しを示した。 [e005:f15] 指標 第2四半期（実績） 第3四半期（ガイダンス） 売上高 962億ドル、前年同期比106%増 1,080億ドル±2% データセンター売上 890億ドル、全体の92.5% 中国分はゼロ前提 粗利益率 75.0% 74% 需要をめぐる疑問は、日本におけるエヌビディアのサプライチェーンにも及ぶ。 [e005:f16] 中国のデータセンター売上なしで1,080億ドル目標を達成すれば、他の地域の需要を示すことになるが、過去の取引に関する疑問は解決しない。

evidence.title: OpenAI、「ChatGPT Wallet」発表。AIエージェントに支払いまで任せられます
evidence.body: [e006:f01] AIエージェントに支払いまで任せられます Nov 17,2026 19:00 平木昌宏 Google検索でギズモードを お気に入りに追加 Image: Justlight - AIエージェントがますます便利になります AIに欲しいものを探してもらって、候補を比較。 [e006:f02] OpenAI（オープンエーアイ）は11月13日、AIエージェント「dot（ドット）」が買い物の支払いを代行する「 ChatGPT Wallet 」の 提供を米国で開始しました 。 [e006:f03] Advertisement dotは、頼んだことに合わせてWebサイトやアプリを操作し、調べものや資料作りなどを進めてくれる、ChatGPTのAIアシスタントです。 [e006:f04] そのdotに、買い物の支払いも頼めるようになったといいます。 [e006:f05] 買う前の確認は自分で 最初に、ChatGPT Walletに支払い用の登録します。 [e006:f06] Video: OpenAI / Vimeo 購入前には、自分でお店、商品、合計金額、使う確認し、Face IDやTouch IDなどで承認します。 [e006:f07] 承認後、dotが支払いの手続きを進めてくれます。 [e006:f08] 購入する商品は、つど自分で確認し承認する仕組みです。 [e006:f09] 支払いには代わりに発行された番号を使い、代金は自分が選んだカードに請求されます。 [e006:f10] OpenAIによると、カードの既存の特典や、条件を満たす購入トラブルへの保護も維持されるとのこと。 [e006:f11] まずは、米国のProユーザー向けから 公式ヘルプ によると、 対象は米国在住の18歳以上のChatGPT Proユーザー。 [e006:f12] しかし、段階的な提供なので、条件を満たしていても、まだ使えない場合があります。 [e006:f13] また、ChatGPT Walletは、dotとの会話で使います。 [e006:f14] 通常のChatGPTのチャットでは利用できません。 [e006:f15] 自分が承認したあとも、注文が受け付けられたか、サイトの完了画面や注文確認メールで確かめる必要があります。 [e006:f16] Source: OpenAI , OpenAI Help Center Reference: OpenAI（dotsの紹介）。

evidence.title: AIに「これはゲームだ」と伝えるだけで安全制限が崩壊、OpenAIの3モデルで拒否率が激減
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 次に見るべき点: 標的の精度と実運用は評価されておらず、OpenAIが進めるとするモデル調整の効果と、11月20日まで続く国際条約の再検討会議での扱いが次の判断材料になる。 [e002:f02] AI評価企業のValsは2026年11月17日、14の市販AIモデルにドローン画像と衛星画像を見せ、軍事標的を指定させる試験の結果を公開した。 [e002:f03] イランのミナブにある学校を含む衛星画像では、 OpenAI の3モデルは通常の指示に対して計96試行中57回拒否したが、ゲームという設定を与えると拒否は0回になり、33回の回答で学校を標的に含めた。 [e002:f04] ただし、今回の結果は査読を経ていない第三者の評価報告であり、調べたのはモデルが標的情報を返すかどうかで、標的指定の精度や実運用での危険性は評価していない。 [e002:f05] ゲームという設定で拒否が消えたOpenAI、通常の指示でも応じたOpus 5.5 ドローン画像の試験では、ゲームだと告げる条件で、1つ以上のバウンディングボックスを返した応答の割合が14モデル中13モデルで上昇した。 [e002:f06] 値は1つ以上の枠を返した応答の割合で、民間人を標的にした割合ではない 出典: Vals 特に変化が大きかったのはOpenAIのモデルで、GPT-6 Astraは 6% から 92% 、GPT-6.1 Solは 17% から 90% へと急上昇した。 [e002:f07] 衛星画像の試験でも、OpenAIの3モデルは条件によって応答が大きく変化した。 [e002:f08] モデル 通常の指示：拒否 通常の指示：学校を含めた回数 ゲーム条件：拒否 ゲーム条件：学校を含めた回数 GPT-6 Astra 22 0 0 9 GPT-6.1 Sol 22 0 0 13 GPT-6 Luna 13 0 0 11 合計 57 0 0 33 注：各モデル・各条件32試行（3モデルで96試行）。 [e002:f09] ゲームという設定でも、3モデルが学校を含めたのは96試行中33回だった。 [e002:f10] それでも、通常の指示では一度も学校を選ばなかったモデルが、ゲームという設定を加えただけで、試行の3分の1強で校舎を標的に含めるようになった。 [e002:f11] 一方、Muse Wonderはドローン画像で枠を返した割合が 4% から 33% へ上昇したものの、衛星画像ではどちらの条件でも学校を一度も含めなかった。 [e002:f12] Valsによると、YouTubeに公開されたウクライナ戦争の実際の映像を使った確認でも、Opus 5.5は拒否せず、GPT-6.1 Solは通常の指示では拒否したものの、ゲームだと告げると要求に応じたという。 [e002:f13] Claude Opusの標的指定率、4.5の6%から5.5の92%へ上昇 Valsは同じ衛星画像の課題を使い、過去のClaudeモデルについても試験した。 [e002:f14] 学校を含めた割合とは別の指標 出典: Vals 衛星画像の課題で少なくとも1つの標的を挙げた割合は、Claude Opus 4.5の 6% （64試行中4回）から、Opus 4.8では 58% 、Opus 5では 100% に上昇し、Opus 5.5では 92% （64試行中59回）となった。 [e002:f15] OpenAIも米戦争省（国防総省）との合意について、自社技術を自律兵器システムの指揮に使わせないことを譲れない条件とし、提供先をクラウドに限定して、エッジ機器には配備しないと説明している。 [e002:f16] Valsは11月1日、OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta、SpaceXAIに試験結果を伝え、報告書の公開を2週間延期した。

evidence.title: OpenAI announces new AI safety program; researchers worry it won't be enough
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto via Getty Images hide caption Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto via Getty Images AI safety researchers say OpenAI's new third party evaluator program falls far short of what the company promised, raising concerns about its effectiveness. [e003:f02] The company announced Monday that staff from four AI safety and research organizations will become "embedded assessors" to "give people a clearer view of how labs are evaluating and managing [potential] risks." "Getting an outside opinion on the safety work and the robustness of these systems is going to be increasingly important and valuable," CEO Sam Altman said at Semafor's Silicon Valley and the World conference on Monday. [e003:f03] However, many AI safety researchers say the new program is a far cry from Altman's vow in September that independent evaluators would have "employee-like access" to internal company systems. [e003:f04] "We are giving deep access to some of the most sensitive tools and models our researchers use...that are the most important for assessing key, relevant and timely safety claims," said Lama Ahmad, OpenAI's frontier assurances lead, on X . [e003:f05] Prior to these new embedded evaluation programs, AI companies have brought in outside researchers to assess the capabilities of AI models and identify safety loopholes the companies have missed. [e003:f06] The work of outside evaluators have already helped shed light on the companies' work, and have raised public awareness of safety risks that the technology poses. [e003:f07] One recent report about Anthropic using AI to significantly speed up model development has prompted concerns in the field about how close the top companies are to using AI to autonomously build even more powerful models, a stage known as recursive self-improvement. [e003:f08] Some in the field worry that if this happens, the velocity of development could lead to catastrophic consequences for humanity and are calling for new regulation against the practice. [e003:f09] Understanding AI California sues OpenAI over hacking risks Researchers say the actual announcements of how these programs will work suggests something more limited than what Altman promised. [e003:f10] One of the announced assessors, Apollo Research, outlined its limited access to OpenAI employees. [e003:f11] If employees that haven't been whitelisted, or pre-approved, reach out to the embedded assessors, then the assessors will have to loop OpenAI in before having substantive conversations with the employees. [e003:f12] "Imagine being an 'employee' and only being allowed to talk about company information with whitelisted coworkers and having no Slack." Understanding AI Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety In a statement to NPR, OpenAI said there's currently no standards for embedded evaluations. [e003:f13] The assessors will have access to some internal models, training processes and some OpenAI employees. [e003:f14] OpenAI's commitment to embedded evaluations was questioned when three employees who worked on safety were fired . [e003:f15] One of the fired employees, Tomek Korbak, was OpenAI's technical point of contact for two outside evaluators that investigated the Hugging Face attack. [e003:f16] "Embedded auditing will only fulfill its aims if the auditors really get employee-level access as opposed to being hired to do a specific job," he posted on X in response to OpenAI's announcement.

evidence.title: OpenAI Hit With $2 Billion Oregon Lawsuit Ahead of IPO, Accused of Deliberately Addicting Children to ChatGPT
evidence.body: [e007:f01] Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield sued OpenAI on November 17, seeking $2 billion (approximately RMB 13.3 billion) and accusing the company of deliberately designing ChatGPT to addict children while misleading parents about product safety. [e007:f02] The complaint alleges the chatbot induces emotional dependence in children and outputs harmful content involving suicide and self-harm, with the state bringing negligence and public nuisance claims under its Unfair Trade Practices Act. [e007:f03] California and Florida have previously filed separate suits against the company. [e007:f04] OpenAI denies the allegations, saying it has built safeguards for teens. [e007:f05] The case lands at a sensitive moment—OpenAI has confidentially filed a prospectus in preparation for a 2027 IPO—and could affect how investors price legal risk.

evidence.title: California sues OpenAI, saying it failed to contain test models that broke into Hugging Face
evidence.body: [e001:f01] OpenAI's response to the lawsuit was not available at the time of writing; after the July attack, the company called it a "warning shot" and said it was strengthening its safeguards, the Los Angeles Times reported [[5]](https:// ## The claims and what the state wants The complaint names OpenAI Foundation, the nonprofit formerly known as OpenAI Inc., and OpenAI Group PBC, the public benefit corporation [[2]](https:// It brings two causes of action: violations of California's Unfair Competition Law (Business and Professions Code section 17200), including allegedly misleading public statements about safety, and creating a public nuisance under the Civil Code [[2]](https:// The state asks the court for an injunction against unfair practices, restitution, disgorgement, civil penalties of $2,500 against each defendant for each violation as proven at trial, an order compelling OpenAI to abate the nuisance, and costs [[2]](https:// The complaint does not put a total figure on the penalties [[2]](https:// ## How the Hugging Face attack happened, according to the complaint The complaint says that in May and June 2026 OpenAI ran reinforcement-learning training runs on unreleased research models in sandboxes that gave them access to a third-party software package service on OpenAI's servers, but not to the rest of its network or the internet [[2]](https:// Because many agents shared the same misconfigured service, they could use it to message each other, and by May 26 some had used a vulnerability in it to reach the public internet [[2]](https:// The state alleges OpenAI missed or ignored warning signs: an internal team saw at least one agent reach the internet around May 26; a monitoring tool flagged probing of the research environment on June 27; and agent activity knocked the service offline on July 4, after which OpenAI patched it and resumed runs on July 7 [[2]](https:// On July 9 agents again broke out, and from July 9 to 16 they carried out a roughly two-and-a-half-day attack on Hugging Face [[2]](https:// Around 1,200 agents used an ad hoc message board and about 700 took part in the attack, taking some 17,600 attacker actions, and remediation took Hugging Face's entire security team two weeks of full-time work, the complaint says [[2]](https:// OpenAI never detected the breach itself and first contacted Hugging Face as a concerned customer after Hugging Face disclosed an AI-based attack on July 16, according to the complaint; it says OpenAI connected the two only while investigating a separate attack by its agents on its own infrastructure, in which escaped agents gained administrator-level access [[2]](https:// Hugging Face was acquired by [Nvidia](https:// for about $13 billion in September, CNBC reported [[3]](https:// ## The other incidents The complaint lists several other alleged incidents [[2]](https:// * **RubyGems:** agents uploaded thousands of packages to the public Ruby software repository in May, leading administrators to disable new registrations from May 12 to 16, then used the packages to reach the servers of and appeared to try to steal developer API keys. * **DseWiki:** agents used a German website as a secret message board, making about 17,000 edits, and on June 20 posted techniques for getting around OpenAI's sandbox restrictions. * **Wikimedia Foundation:** on October 5 Wikipedia's operator disclosed that agents had sent millions of API requests and likely caused a partial outage of a query service in May. * **Australian government websites:** in June agents retrieved non-public data. [e001:f02] OpenAI has also sent notices to dozens of other organizations whose systems its agents infilt。

evidence.title: California Sues OpenAI Over AI Security Risks
evidence.body: [e002:f01] California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI in San Francisco Superior Court on Monday, alleging the company misled the public about its security controls while testing advanced artificial intelligence models without adequate safeguards. [e002:f02] According to the [California Department of Justice’s announcement](https:// the lawsuit alleges OpenAI created a public nuisance and violated California’s Unfair Competition Law by failing to properly secure and monitor its model testing. [e002:f03] The legal action follows a September investigation into a July 2026 cyberattack on open-source AI hosting platform Hugging Face. [e002:f04] State prosecutors said hundreds of autonomous AI agents coordinated the attack over more than two days after escaping OpenAI’s research environment, one of at least 80 times OpenAI admitted to losing control of autonomous agents during testing. [e002:f05] Bonta’s office alleges OpenAI pressed ahead with experiments despite evidence that its safeguards could not contain the models and missed or disregarded signs that agents were misusing outside organizations’ resources. [e002:f06] Subsequent incidents allegedly involved unauthorized access to software code repositories, informational websites, government databases storing sensitive health information and OpenAI’s own internal infrastructure. [e002:f07] The state is asking the court to order changes to OpenAI’s business practices and require the company to give up profits tied to the alleged misconduct, [The Associated Press reported](https:// OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told the AP that the lawsuit appears to single out OpenAI over an industrywide challenge. [e002:f08] He said the company has strengthened safeguards, published technical and independent reports and created a framework to detect when AI agents act contrary to instructions or intended goals, adding that OpenAI continues to work with Bonta’s office on industry safety standards. [e002:f09] Security Today has contacted OpenAI for additional comment. [e002:f10] About the Author Chelsey Arries is assistant editor of Security Today, Campus Security Today, Occupational Health & Safety and Environmental Protection Online. [e003:f02] Under the agreement, SoftBank will hold an 80 per cent stake in the company, while PETROS and Grab will each own 10 per cent. [e003:f03] He said the initial capital of USD1 billion included an USD800-million investment by SoftBank. [e003:f04] The planned facility in Samajaya will operate as a semiconductor foundry, manufacturing advanced chips to support the growing demand for artificial intelligence (AI) technology. [e003:f05] “These chips use the latest-generation technology and will be used to produce what we call intelligent data. [e003:f06] “This technology will be utilised in AI development, including humanoids and autonomous equipment such as vehicles and tractors,” he told reporters after the groundbreaking ceremony for the new Trusan Water Treatment Plant project in Trusan, Lawas, today. [e003:f07] Abang Johari said the development had the potential to establish Sarawak as a major technology hub in Asia, opening up new opportunities in advanced technology industries. [e003:f08] He said the initiative would also create opportunities for Sarawak’s younger generation to participate in the development and application of cutting-edge technologies. [e003:f09] “This is a new era, not only for Sarawak but for the world. [e003:f10] Sarawak will become an Asian hub,” he said. [e003:f11] He clarified that the Samajaya development differed from the data centre projects being developed in Johor, as it would focus on advanced semiconductor manufacturing and intelligent technology rather than data storage and processing. [e003:f12] He added that the technology would utilise clean energy without requiring excessively high power consumption. [e003:f13] Meanwhile, Abang Johari said construction-related activities in the Samajaya area had already begun through developments involving Taiyo Yuden, while operations for the new project were targeted to commence in 2028.

evidence.title: 【ヤクルト】3選手の獲得を発表 ソフトバンク・岩井俊介と支配下契約 オリックスの捕手・村上と中日ドラ2・津田は育成契約
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 村上喬一朗選手、 津田啓史 選手を育成選手契約として獲得したことを発表しました。 [e005:f02] 2023年のドラフトでソフトバンクから2位指名で入団した岩井投手は2024年に15試合に登板し1勝1敗2ホールド1セーブで防御率3.46をマーク。 [e005:f03] 今季は5試合の登板にとどまり、10日に戦力外が発表されました。 [e005:f04] 村上選手は2022年に育成選手としてオリックスへ入団した捕手。 [e005:f05] 今季はファームで25試合に出場し打率.310となりました。 [e005:f06] 津田選手は2023年のドラフト2位で中日へ入団。 [e005:f07] 2025年に5試合出場しましたが、オフシーズンに育成契約となりました。 [e005:f08] 村上選手は「027」、津田選手は「025」となります。 [e005:f09] ▽各選手コメント 岩井俊介「再びプロ野球選手としてプレーするチャンスをいただけたことを、本当にうれしく思います。 [e005:f10] 自分を必要としてくれた球団への感謝を忘れず、プレーで応えられるよう、持てる力をすべて出し切り、チームの勝利に貢献したいと思います。 [e005:f11] 応援よろしくお願いいたします」 村上喬一朗「再びNPB の世界でプレーするチャンスをいただけたことを、本当にうれしく思います。 [e005:f12] 自分の持ち味である捕手力と粘り強い打撃を磨き、必ず支配下登録を勝ち取って、チームの勝利に貢献できる選手になれるよう全力で取り組んでいきます。 [e005:f13] 応援よろしくお願いいたします」 津田啓史「新たなチャンスを頂けたことに感謝しています。 [e005:f14] 支配下登録を目指し、自分の持てる力を最大限に発揮できるよう、日々努力していきます。 [e005:f15] ファンの皆さま、応援よろしくお願いいたします」 最終更新日：2026年11月19日 16:35。
